title: U.S. Shoppers Verify AI Recommendations Before Buying
discussion_signal: The company survey reports that shoppers use AI for product research but usually check recommendations against reviews, brands, friends, or search before buying. Discussion therefore treats AI as a curation layer while preserving human verification and spending agency.
linked_research_question: When AI enters product discovery, what keeps shoppers in control of verification, trust, and the final spending decision?
limits: The survey is produced and promoted by a company in the AI-commerce market
Self-reported verification is not observed purchase behavior
